questions.stem: What is the sum of the measures of all the angles of a pentagon?
questions.solution: The sum of the measures of all the angles of a pentagon can be calculated by the formula (n-2) × 180°, where n is the number of sides. For a pentagon, n = 5. So, (5-2) × 180° = 3 × 180° = 540°. The other options are incorrect because they do not follow the formula correctly.

hi.stem: एक पंचभुज के सभी कोणों के मापों का योग क्या है?
hi.solution: एक पंचभुज के सभी कोणों के मापों का योग सूत्र (n-2) × 180° द्वारा गणना की जा सकती है, जहां n भुजाओं की संख्या है। पंचभुज के लिए, n = 5। इसलिए, (5-2) × 180° = 3 × 180° = 540°। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे सूत्र का सही तरीके से अनुसरण नहीं करते हैं।

questions.stem: What is the sum of the measures of all the angles of a triangle?
questions.solution: The sum of the measures of all the angles of a triangle is always 180°, which is a fundamental property of triangles in Euclidean geometry. 120° is too small, as it does not account for all three angles. 270° and 360° are too large, as they exceed the total angle sum for any triangle.

hi.stem: एक त्रिभुज के सभी कोणों के मापों का योग क्या है?
hi.solution: एक त्रिभुज के सभी कोणों के मापों का योग हमेशा 180° होता है, जो यूक्लिडियन ज्यामिति में त्रिभुजों का एक मूलभूत गुण है। 120° बहुत कम है, क्योंकि यह सभी तीन कोणों को ध्यान में नहीं रखता है। 270° और 360° बहुत अधिक हैं, क्योंकि ये किसी भी त्रिभुज के कुल कोण योग के अतिरिक्त हैं।

questions.stem: If a five-pointed star has a regular pentagon inside it, and one angle of the star is 36°, what is the measure of each angle in the pentagon?
questions.solution: In a regular pentagon, each interior angle is 108°. This is calculated using the formula (n-2) × 180° / n, where n = 5. For a pentagon, (5-2) × 180° / 5 = 540° / 5 = 108°. The other options do not match the correct calculation.

questions.stem: If a star has six points and a regular hexagon is formed inside it, what will be the measure of each angle in the hexagon?
questions.solution: In a regular hexagon, each interior angle is 120°. This is calculated using the formula (n-2) × 180° / n, where n = 6. For a hexagon, (6-2) × 180° / 6 = 720° / 6 = 120°. The other options do not match the correct calculation.

questions.stem: If a star has 10 points and a regular decagon is formed inside it, what will be the measure of each angle in the decagon?

questions.stem: In a 6×10 grid, 12 pentominoes are used to complete the rectangle. What will be the number of pentominoes required to complete a 5×12 grid?
questions.solution: Each pentomino covers 5 squares. A 6×10 grid has 60 squares, and 60 ÷ 5 = 12 pentominoes. A 5×12 grid also has 60 squares, so 60 ÷ 5 = 12 pentominoes. The option '10' is incorrect because it assumes a different number of squares. '15' and '20' are incorrect as they suggest more pentominoes than needed.

questions.stem: A pentomino is formed by connecting 5 squares side-by-side. If each square has an area of 1 unit, what is the total area of a pentomino?
